chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

It is recommended that you perform three hundred and sixty circuits (usbu'at), which is the number of the days of the year. So if you are not able, then three hundred and sixty shawt (half-circuits). So if you are not able, then whatever you are able to perform of the Tawaf.

key_terms.أُسْبُوعاً: Circuits (plural of usbu', a specific measure of circuits)
key_terms.شَوْطاً: Shawt (half-circuits or a specific length of circuit)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended number of circuits for Tawaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the recommended (mustahabb) practice of performing 360 circuits (usbu'at) during Tawaf, symbolically aligning the ritual with the 360 days of the pre-Islamic lunar calendar to signify completeness. It demonstrates the Shia scholarly emphasis on voluntary acts of worship that mirror cosmic order, while providing practical flexibility (rukhas) for those unable to fulfill the full count, reflecting the juristic principle of ease in religious obligations.
